briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI accelerate frontier releases as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has entered a high-velocity phase with multiple labs shipping advanced models weekly. Funding remains robust while safety gaps widen. Prompt injection threats continue to dominate production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o3-pro with expanded agentic capabilities. xAI launched Grok-4 and DeepSeek unveiled R2. Anthropic and Google DeepMind are expected to counter within days.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA and TSMC report record H200 shipments. Microsoft and Google expand dedicated AI data centers in Texas and Arizona. Sovereign compute initiatives accelerate in EU and UAE.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks or technical breakthroughs like dialect-based security arrive first to stabilize multi-agent deployments?
